slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Define what an **API** is.
• Explain the role of an **API** in **AI** applications.
• Identify how an **API** facilitates interaction with **AI** models.

slides.title: What is an API? The Restaurant Waiter Analogy
slides.narration:
What exactly is an **API**?
An **API** acts as a messenger.
It helps applications talk to **AI** models.
Imagine an **API** is like a restaurant waiter.
You give your order, which is a **prompt**.
The waiter takes it to the kitchen, the **AI** model.
The kitchen prepares your food, the **AI** response.
The waiter brings it back to you.
You don't need to know how the food is made.
The **API** handles all communication for you.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing a restaurant waiter taking an order from a customer and delivering it to the kitchen, representing an API connecting an application to an AI model.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We understood that an **API** acts as a messenger.
It connects applications with **AI** models.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration: Now, here is an assignment for you. Think of another everyday analogy to explain how an **API** works. Compare the results.
